title_zh: 决定先了解校园咨询服务

scenario.label_zh: 决定先了解校园咨询服务
scenario.goal_zh: 表达对公开发言的顾虑，并选择先阅读首次会谈说明而不立即预约

context_zh: 虚构美国大学：学生和同学讨论如何了解校园心理咨询服务，不作诊断或治疗建议。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Every presentation makes me want to skip class. I'm starting to contemplate dropping the course.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Would you consider talking to a counselor before making that decision?

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Maybe. I keep telling myself I should conquer my nerves alone.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: You don't have to prove anything by doing it alone. The campus counseling service has a page explaining how the first conversation works.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Could we look at that page together? I want to know what I would be agreeing to.

sentences.speaker: Dylan
sentences.text: Sure. We can read it now, and you can decide whether to contact them.

sentences.speaker: Maya
sentences.text: Let's do that. I'm not ready to book, but I do want to understand the service.
